note: Older fishing-and-hunting park on SR-78 near Lakeport, about 2 mi from Lake Okeechobee and across the highway from the rim canal. Bar and cabins. Park models and long-stay units fill the south half; the transient row backs onto the pond. Also bookable on Hipcamp. --Claude
summary: Operator site and ResNexus: confirmed $50/night RV sites (Dec 2026 and Jun 2027 quotes), one-night bookings, back-in only; added laundry.
